anf_compare.notes: No public-domain English of On Pascha exists (Toura 1941; Daly ACW 54 and Witte's German are copyrighted and were not copied). Sense checked against the locked Witte Greek (and, for 1.94, Victor of Capua's Latin as Witte prints it) and the wording of the cited scriptures.

bible_refs.note: The destroyer's power stopped by the blood.
The one who has the power of death abolished — possible.

pass_a_gloss: [gap] which we sacrifice, and we anoint our houses with blood, I mean our body, which anointing is the faith into him, through which we believe the destroyer's power being abolished.
pass_b_english: [lacuna] which we sacrifice, and we anoint our houses with blood — I mean our body. That anointing is the faith in him, through which we believe that the destroyer's power is being abolished (Exodus 12:7) (Exodus 12:23) (Hebrews 2:14).
